statement: For either signed Collatz coefficient operator, every positive odd target a and depths d,b>=0, the finite inverse coefficient B_(d,b), defined by spending each positive halving exponent from the remaining total budget b, satisfies 0<=K_d(a)-B_(d,b)(a)<=6^d*(3/4)^b. Its terminal weights depend only on actual positive odd depth-d ancestors at most a*2^b. Thus B_(d,8d) loses at most (19683/32768)^d, its depth series is summable exactly when the complete coefficient series is, and partial sums differ by at most 32768/13085. At a nonperiodic target, nonsummability of the finite-budget series implies nonsummability of the ordinary reciprocal series of actual positive odd unit ancestors, for both signs. Neither divergence premise, a quantitative Juggler estimate, nor termination is proved. Kernel-checked; independent review and advisory statement coverage pending.
